system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: CARDS NCT00327418 - CARDS Is Designed To Show If Lowering Cholesterol With Atorvastatin In Type 2 Diabetics Without CV Disease Reduces The Risk Of CV Events
Investigational drug: atorvastatin
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00327418 CARDS (registry, published 2006-05-18, source ctgov:NCT00327418@2003-06-16)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00327418 (CARDS)
Title: CARDS Is Designed To Show If Lowering Cholesterol With Atorvastatin In Type 2 Diabetics Without CV Disease Reduces The Risk Of CV Events
Official title: A Double Blind Placebo Controlled Study of Atorvastatin as Prevention of CHD in High Risk Patients With Non-Insulin Dependent Diabetes Mellitus (Collaborative Atorvastatin Study - CARDS)
Sponsor: Pfizer
Phase: PHASE4
Conditions: Major Coronary Event; Cerebrovascular Accident; Coronary Artery Bypass Graft; Angina, Unstable; Revascularization
Interventions: Atorvastatin (DRUG)
Start date: 1997-01
Enrollment: 2800 (None)
Primary outcome(s): Time from randomization to the occurrence of a primary clinical endpoint | i.e. major coronary event or CABG or other coronary revascularization procedure | or unstable angina or resuscitated cardiac arrest or stroke.
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients must have a documented history of at least one of the following:

* Hypertension (defined as systolic blood pressure 140 mmHg or a diastolic blood pressure 90 mmHg (defined as the disapperance of all sound \[Korotkoff Phase V\] or receiving anti-hypertensive treatment. Blood pressure should be measured after sitting the patient quietly for 3 minutes).
* Retinopathy (defined as any of the following; non-proliferative retinopathy, pre-pre-proliferative retinopathy, proliferative retinopathy, maculopathy, advanced diabetic eye disease or history of photocoagulation).
* Microalbuminuria (defined as either, Albumin creatinine ratio \> than = to 2.5 mg/mmol, or Albumin excretion rate on a timed collection \> than = to 20 mcg/min (\> than = to 30 mg/24hrs) on two successive occasions, or a positive micral or other strip test).
* Macroalbuminuria (defined as either; Albustix or other dipstick evidence of gross proteinuria, Albumin creatinine ratio \> than = to 25 mg/mmol; or Albumin excretion rate on a timed collection \> than = 200 mcg/min (\> than = 300 mg/24hrs) on two sucessive occasions).
* Current smoker

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type I Diabetes Mellitus
* Any major Coronary event prior to entry into the study
Brief summary: A study to assess the efficacy of once daily atorvastatin 10 mg versus placebo on cardiovascular endpoints in patients with non-insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus (NIDDM) who have a history of either hypertension, retinopathy, microalbuminuria, macroalbuminuria, or who currently smoke, but who do not have established corornary heart disease or other macrovascular disease.
--- END ---
